question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 35, 26, 56, 41, 56, 46, 34, 16 and 68 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 40.

Deviations from 40: −5, −14, +16, +1, +16, +6, −6, −24, +28

Sum of deviations = (−5 − 14 − 6 − 24) + (16 + 1 + 16 + 6 + 28) = −49 + 67 = +18

Average deviation = +18 ÷ 9 = +2

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average deviation = 40 + 2 = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 35, 26, 56, 41, 56, 46, 34, 16, 68

Number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations
